rows.role_title: 中央委員会議長 — Central Committee chair
rows.text: The party's text of 不破議長's closing address on the final day, 24 November ('日本共産党第２２回大会最終日の１１月２４日'), has him say that in the new structure he takes up the office of Central Committee chair ('新しい体制のなかで、私は中央委員会議長の任にあたることになりました').

locator.section: heading, introductory sentence and the passage on the new structure

rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: In the same address he says that in national politics the new Executive Committee chair 志位和夫 will represent the party ('志位和夫新委員長が党を代表する役割をはたすことになります').

locator.section: the passage on the new structure
